# Draft Recruiter Communication

Read `AGENTS.md`, local `AboutMe.md`, `Job-Applications/[company]/job.txt`, and an optional local `email.txt` recruiter message. Create `email.md` for a reply or outreach, or `cover-letter.md` if an application letter is requested. Use only supported private facts. Do not claim submission or send messages.
